By 2024, the Discharger plans to complete its treatment capacity expansion at RP-5 and will add a biosolids handling process, to RP-5, that will consist one (1) acid phase digester, three (3) gas phase digesters, one (1) digested sludge storage tank, and associated ancillary equipment.

Also, the four (4) existing secondary clarifiers and the tertiary sand-media filters will be demolished and a new 10 membrane bioreactor (MBR) units will be built (8 equipped with membranes and two left for future expansion) and will include eight (8) filtrate pumps, two (2) back-pulse pumps, and four (4) air scour blowers.
